items.q: as long as I know all that family and ever'thing

ctx.x: And still writing. You're writing religious music now, you told me.
Well, I wrote it for this "Biddy Mason." Yeah. Yeah, I wrote whole gangs down there--ten or twelve songs--for...uh, "Biddy Mason.
In the book Mr. Jelly Roll by Alan Lomax--have you seen this book?
